svg.text: Three techniques: where the payload hides inside an Authenticode-signed PE
← SigFlip does NOT touch this area
Between end of PKCS#7 DER and dwLength boundary
NOT valid ASN.1 — raw injected bytes
Capacity: ~tens of KB (limited by padding space)
MS13-098 registry key rejects padding after DER blob
Detected by cert padding scanners (YARA, osquery)
Custom OID in unsignedAttrs · Inside the PKCS#7 DER
⚠ Custom OID — flaggable by OID scanner
No padding — payload is inside the DER blob
Detectable: custom OID can be flagged by anomaly scanner
✓ Known Microsoft OID — blends in naturally
No padding — inside DER, inside a known OID wrapper
Known OID, valid ASN.1, looks like a real nested signature
SigFlip: raw bytes in cert padding
SigStash Direct: OCTET STRING in unsignedAttrs
✅ EnableCertPaddingCheck · ✅ OID scanners · ✅ known Microsoft OID · 16MB+
